src/records.rs: StudioDesignRecords (hsk.studio.design_records@1) = standalone sidecar of ONE document (document_id must equal the document's) holding nodes: Vec<StudioNodeDesign{node: NodeRef, auto_layout, child_layout, size_clamps, constraints, reactions, component_property_references, explicit_variable_modes, style_refs}>, components, component_sets, component_instances, variable_collections, variables, paint_styles. validate_design_records(&records, &StudioDocument, Budget, &CancellationToken, &dyn Resolver) -> Result<Vec<ResolutionIssue>> validates every record, then: node exists with the right kind and is unique; auto_layout only on artboards/group layers; child_layout only when the parent is a HORIZONTAL/VERTICAL container; constraints refused on a flow child unless ABSOLUTE (STU-DS-048) and on a root node; reaction destinations are document nodes, SET_VARIABLE/SET_VARIABLE_MODE targets exist with matching type/mode; component_property_references only on layers inside a component definition; explicit_variable_modes only on containers and only to existing collection modes; style_refs names the closed six and SSTY ids (unknown ids -> ResolutionIssue via Resolver::primitive on hsk.studio.style_registry@1); components/sets sit on group layers, set membership = components whose layer is a child of the set layer, default_variant_id is a member, every member assigns every property with a declared value (VariantAssignmentIncomplete), no two members share an assignment (VariantAssignmentDuplicate), variant_properties only inside a set; instances name a component (not a set) and typed properties exist on the component or its set with equal type and compatible bound variables; every variable has exactly the collection's modes, collection.variable_ids equals the variables that name it, alias targets exist with equal type and the union alias graph is acyclic (VariableAliasCycle). validate_paint_style(&style, Budget, &token, &dyn Resolver) validates one style without a document; choice_no_new_fields.decision: All new collections live in ONE standalone serializable set, StudioDesignRecords, validated against a StudioDocument by validate_design_records. No field was added to StudioDocument, StudioLayer, StudioPageSpread, StudioArtboard or LayerAppearance, and no new Payload kind.
choice_no_new_fields.why: Struct-literal constructors exist outside folio for StudioLayer (components folio_bridge + test, interop-vector svg_adapter, interop-psd test, layout example + test), LayerAppearance (interop-vector) and StudioDocument (interop-media, pulse); the spec puts these fields on StudioLayer/StudioDocument, so any added field would break them. Folio has no existing extensible map; the existing extension mechanism (PrimitiveReference payload) cannot hold a container with children because only group layers can be parents.
choice_no_new_fields.consequence: The spec's 'fields on a node' (layout_mode, constraints, reactions, component_property_references, explicit_variable_modes, the six style-reference fields) are keyed by node id in StudioNodeDesign. Old documents are byte-identical (test asserts the document JSON round-trips unchanged); the records are not a document member and are not inspected by inspect_bytes/extension().
